continuationAnchor: Lesson 31 trains complex object after made/let/heard/saw/felt/helped.
Lesson 32 mixes be used to + V-ing, relative clauses, reported speech, passive, and need/want + object + V3.
Lesson 33 narrows that bridge into have/get something done with controlled B2 phrase progression.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Focused continuation after Lesson 32 object-result patterns.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Arrange an action/result without saying the learner did it personally.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may confuse I repaired it with I had it repaired.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: Lesson 32 already introduces need/want + object + V3, so Lesson 33 safely narrows that bridge into one B2 pattern.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Unreal present and regret without broad C1 overload.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Express unreal present wishes and controlled regrets.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may overuse would after wish with the same subject.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After Lesson 33 result control, the course shifts into unreal meaning before full conditionals.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Past unreal cause and result.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Build if + past perfect, would have + V3 sentences.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may mix second and third conditional forms too early.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: Wish/regret gives the meaning first; third conditional then adds the full cause-result frame.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Controlled present result from past condition.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Connect a past unreal cause to a present result.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may treat every mixed conditional as free-form tense mixing.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It comes only after third conditional basics, so the timeline shift is explicit and not random.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Duration and visible result.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Explain ongoing activity leading to a present result.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may use it with stative verbs or confuse it with simple present perfect.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After unreal-condition work, the course returns to high-frequency tense control before adding past/future complexity.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Background duration before a past event.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Show an activity continuing before another past point.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may overuse it where past simple is enough.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It naturally extends Lesson 37 duration logic into past narrative sequencing.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Future process and completion.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Separate future activity in progress from future completion by a deadline.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may choose forms by translation instead of time perspective.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After present/past perfect continuous, future aspect completes the B2 tense-aspect set.

curriculumRoadmap.role: must have, might have, cannot have.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Make past deductions with modal + have + V3.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may confuse deduction with obligation or advice.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It uses the V3 confidence built in Lessons 33, 35, and 39 before the B2+ nuance block.

curriculumRoadmap.role: have to, need to, be supposed to, be allowed to.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Choose obligation, expectation, necessity, and permission with nuance.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may flatten all forms into must/can.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It starts B2+ with meaning nuance, using modal control from Lesson 40.

curriculumRoadmap.role: although, even though, despite, in spite of.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Express contrast inside one sentence with clause vs phrase patterns.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may write despite that or although of.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After modal nuance, the course expands sentence architecture without jumping to C1.

curriculumRoadmap.role: so that, in order to, such that, so/such.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Distinguish purpose from result in longer sentences.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may confuse so that purpose with so result.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It pairs with Lesson 42: contrast first, purpose/result next.

curriculumRoadmap.role: therefore, however, nevertheless, whereas.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Link ideas across clauses and sentences with formal connectors.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may use connectors mechanically without matching logic.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It consolidates Lessons 42-43 into discourse-level control.

curriculumRoadmap.role: what I need, where we met, whether it works.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Use whole clauses as subjects, objects, and complements.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may keep question word order inside noun clauses.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After connector work, learners are ready for clause-as-unit grammar.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Embedded questions and reporting verbs.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Report questions with embedded word order and tense control.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may write asked where did he go.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: Noun clauses make embedded question structure teachable instead of memorized.

curriculumRoadmap.role: admit, deny, suggest, warn, promise.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Select the correct grammar pattern after common reporting verbs.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may attach every reporting verb to a that clause.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It broadens reporting after Lesson 46 while keeping pattern choice explicit.

curriculumRoadmap.role: It is said that, he is believed to.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Build formal impersonal reporting structures.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may mix it is said to he or he is said that.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It is the formal passive extension of Lessons 46-47 before participle compression.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Walking home, having finished, seen from here.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Compress time, reason, and passive meaning into participle clauses.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may create dangling participles.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It uses strong V3/passive control from Lessons 33 and 48.

curriculumRoadmap.role: people living here, documents checked yesterday.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Reduce relative clauses into active and passive participle modifiers.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may confuse reduced relatives with full participle clauses.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It completes the B2+ clause-compression block before C1 emphasis and inversion.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Never have I, only then did I.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Use subject-auxiliary inversion after fronted negative or limiting adverbials.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may invert without an inversion trigger.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It opens C1 only after conditionals, modal control, and clause work are stable.

curriculumRoadmap.role: What I need is, It was John who.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Move important information into focused cleft structures.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may overbuild heavy sentences with unclear focus.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: After inversion, the course teaches a second C1 emphasis tool with less word-order risk.

curriculumRoadmap.role: I do understand, he did call.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Add spoken/written emphasis with do and auxiliary stress.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may use emphatic do where tense or register makes it awkward.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It follows heavier C1 emphasis structures with a compact high-frequency emphasis tool.

curriculumRoadmap.role: seems to, appears to, is likely to.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Make cautious claims instead of overstrong statements.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may hedge every sentence or mix certainty levels.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It builds directly from deduction and formal reporting into C1 academic/professional stance.

curriculumRoadmap.role: aware of, responsible for, the fact that.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Attach clauses and prepositional complements to adjectives and nouns accurately.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may translate complements word-for-word from L1.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: Hedging needs precise complement patterns, so this stabilizes the grammar behind C1 claims.

curriculumRoadmap.role: dependent on, associated with, involved in.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Control fixed preposition patterns in formal and professional phrases.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may memorize lists without phrase-level production.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It follows complement work so prepositions are learned as grammar slots, not isolated words.

curriculumRoadmap.role: thereby, hence, consequently, due to.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: State formal cause and consequence across clauses and sentences.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may overuse formal connectors in casual phrases.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It upgrades the B2+ connector block with C1 register and precision.

curriculumRoadmap.role: arguably, admittedly, presumably, supposedly.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Signal stance, evaluation, and source attitude in compact adverbials.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may choose stance adverbs by translation, not speaker attitude.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It completes the C1 claim-making sequence before integrated review.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Integrated production with controlled complexity.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Combine causative, clauses, reporting, inversion, emphasis, and stance in one controlled set.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may pass recognition but fail mixed production.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It is the stress test before the final bridge review, not a new grammar overload.

curriculumRoadmap.role: Course capstone and readiness for future C1 modules.
curriculumRoadmap.newSkill: Demonstrate readiness for later C1 modules through integrated review and self-correction.
curriculumRoadmap.risk: Learners may need more recycling before moving into denser C1 material.
curriculumRoadmap.whyHere: It caps the 33-60 expansion and decides what future C1 modules should recycle first.

integrationPolicy: This pipeline creates review artifacts only. App source integration requires a separate explicit approval step.
